diablo-original-combat.title: Diablo — original dungeon combat
diablo-original-combat.sourceDate: Retrieved 8 October 2026; historical gameplay frame, exact capture date and build unconfirmed.
diablo-original-combat.basis: Bounded criticism/review reproduction in an independently authored analysis. No bespoke permission obtained; Blizzard’s video and personal-use wording is not treated as blanket still-image permission. Source and named author are credited, and the actual frame is needed to examine the interface and its history.
diablo-original-combat.purpose: The original game’s isometric encounter, health and mana reservoirs and immediately available controls establish what persists beneath the series’ changing business.
diablo-original-combat.treatment: One complete source frame per historical subject, preserved without removal of marks or color alteration. Responsive WebP derivatives; no ripped textures, game models, soundtrack or downloadable gallery.
